critique.evidence: Frame timing is stable on tablet/mobile (~16.67 ms average, 16.8 ms worst, 0 long frames); desktop is acceptable but slower at 20.73 ms average and 33.4 ms worst. However, standard-motion sampling across all three viewports found 0 active animations and 0 changed elements over 12 frames, so the toggle/reveal motion, easing, continuity, and responsiveness are not demonstrated. Reduced-motion mode shows no visual changes but still reports 1 active animation and 76 transition-bearing elements, leaving incomplete proof that motion is fully suppressed.
